full_page.content:
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, C, F.M. Cap.
1946, Nov. 1
POST CARD
"O all ye works of the Lord! Bless the Lord. 11 November Ist All Saints 1946.
God bless you Mrs. Alice - Grandma Plunkett -- yourself and all the Plunkett Family and Clan.
I surely thank you for your practical way of remember- ing me on my 76th birthday. I hope the dear Lord may be pleased to leave yourself with us till you round out the 100. After all that cant be much more than a dozen years. So take courage and stay till your ripe enough for Heaven to take a "no stop-passage." . . God's blessing and graces to yourself and to all our dear friends in Detroit.
Sincerely yours in Christ.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Praised be Jesus Christ!
Original in possession of :
Mildred M. Morrin
5983 Greenwoode Road, Apt. 4210
Pontiac, Michigan 48054
Received: March 25, 1977
